items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: He had me, had me get a band together with Santo... And, and we made these records... we did that, that, uh, that, uh, Treasury show.

ctx.x: That, that's the whole deal. I mean, there's nobody, nobody says, well, you win and I, I lost and so forth. But, but, I mean, just everybody, they, they just felt, uh, well, we cut him a brand new one, you know. Just like, just like I was telling you about, uh, Roger, what's his name, uh, I showed you the picture that we did this Treasury broadcast.
